crashed.instructions:
1. If you updated the app or WebView2 — tap "Try again" to see if the issue is fixed.
2. If the issue persists — the plugin likely isn't compatible with your device right now. You can keep using the other plugins and tools.
3. If it's a plugin that works for others — report it to development with your version number.

tour.autoplay_subtitle: Auto-play — moves between steps automatically every 4 seconds

steps.restart_welcome_body_loaded:
The tour will walk you through Otzaria's main features.
Tap "I'm ready" when you're ready to start.
steps.restart_welcome_body_empty:
A short tour will be shown without a loaded library.
After loading the library you'll be able to see the full tour.
Tap "I'm ready" when you're ready to start.
steps.welcome_body_loaded: A free and open digital Torah library. Would you like a short tour of the main features? (about 2 minutes)
steps.welcome_body_empty:
A free and open digital Torah library.

Since you haven't loaded a library yet, a short tour will be shown. After loading the library you'll be able to re-run the full tour from: Settings ← System.
steps.navigation_body:
In the highlighted area you'll find all parts of the app: library, find, reading, search, tools, and settings.

Shortcuts: {shortcuts}
steps.library_body: All available books are shown here. You can browse by category, search by name, or open a book with a tap.
steps.library_search_body: Type a book name, author, or topic here — the library will filter instantly.
steps.categories_body: Tap a category to switch to it: Tanach, Mishna, Talmud, Halacha, Kabbalah, Thought, and more.
steps.open_book_body: Double-tap a book to open it for reading. A single tap shows a preview with book details on the side.
steps.find_ref_body:
When you know where to go, type a book name, chapter, or verse. Find = navigate, Search = discover.

Shortcut: {shortcut}
steps.reading_body:
Read the books you opened here. You can open multiple books in different tabs and switch between them.

Shortcut: {shortcut}
steps.tabs_body: Every book you open appears as a separate tab. Ctrl+Tab switches between tabs, and workspaces save collections of tabs.
steps.toc_body: Tap to navigate directly to a chapter or section in the book. A navigation panel opens on the side with all chapters.
steps.commentators_body: Choose whether commentaries are displayed next to the text, beneath it, or in page-shape view.
steps.bookmark_body: Tap to bookmark your current spot. General history is saved automatically. To return to saved places, find bookmarks and history at the top of the screen.
steps.book_search_body: Search for a word or phrase only in the current book. Results are highlighted within the text.
steps.reading_settings_body: Open the reading settings panel: font size, font family, vowels, line spacing, and display mode.
steps.print_body: Print the current chapter with the format you've chosen — including commentaries if they are shown.
steps.side_by_side_body: Right-click a tab and select Show side by side — two books will display next to each other with a draggable divider.
steps.advanced_search_body_loaded:
Search any word or phrase across all books at once. You can filter by category and jump to any result.

Shortcut: {shortcut}
steps.advanced_search_body_empty: Advanced search will be available after loading the library. It's meant for finding an idea or word when you don't know where it appears.
steps.tools_body:
Here you'll find a Hebrew calendar, gematria, Aramaic dictionary, acronyms, unit converter, learning plan, and personal notes.

Shortcut: {shortcut}
steps.calendar_body: Hebrew-Gregorian calendar with prayer times by location, Daf Yomi for Talmud Bavli, and more.
steps.gematria_body: Enter a word to get its gematria, or look up words by gematria value.
steps.notes_body: Add personal notes anywhere in any book. Notes are saved on the device and can be exported.
steps.settings_body:
Customize appearance, text, library, tools, shortcuts, backup, and more here.

Shortcut: {shortcut}
steps.appearance_body: Choose light or dark mode, a base color for the interface, and fullscreen mode.
steps.backup_body: Save a backup of your bookmarks, history, and notes, and restore at any time — even after a reinstall. The backup can be exported.
steps.shortcuts_body:
View all available keyboard shortcuts and customize them.

{table}
steps.finish_body_loaded: Now you're ready to explore the library. You can run the tour again at any time from: Settings ← System ← Run tour again.
steps.finish_body_empty: After loading the library, you'll be able to run the full tour from: Settings ← System ← Run tour again.
steps.empty_library_title: Let's start by setting up the library
steps.empty_library_body: To use Otzaria, you need a library of books. You can download the library, choose an existing folder, or extract from a ZIP file.

tour.compare_books_body: It looks like you keep switching between the same books. Right-click on one of the tabs here and choose "Show side by side".
tour.word_meaning_title: There's a definition available for the word you marked
tour.word_meaning_body: The marked word has an acronym expansion or an Aramaic definition available here. Right-click it to see the option.
tour.open_commentaries_body: This book has commentaries available. You can open the side bar with the nearby button to work faster.
